name: jeffort
description: Jeffort scores each prompt with TypeSafe Jev and sets Claude's effort level for the turn, never touching the model

enabled.title: Automatic effort
enabled.description: Choose the effort level for each turn from Jev's score. Off leaves your /effort setting alone and starts every session off, whatever /jeffort last set; /jeffort on still works for that session.

subagents.title: Subagents too
subagents.description: Also choose the effort for subagents, scored once on the task each is given. Agents whose definition sets their own effort, forks and teammates are always left alone.

ceiling.title: Highest effort to use
ceiling.description: Jev never picks above this level. max is off by default because it costs the most tokens.

floor.title: Lowest effort to use
floor.description: Jev never picks below this level.
